summary: This Form 6-K announces the pricing and closing of Micware Co., Ltd.'s initial public offering. The company sold 2,850,000 American Depositary Shares (ADSs) at $8.00 per ADS on a firm commitment basis, raising $22.8 million in gross proceeds. The underwriter is A.G.P./Alliance Global Partners. The ADSs are listed on Nasdaq under ticker MWC. Proceeds will fund the DSMM project, expansion of its in-vehicle infotainment platform, general corporate purposes, strategic investments, and marketing. There is a 45-day over-allotment option for up to 427,500 additional ADSs. This is a standard IPO closing report, not a special situation.
